- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant congratulated the user on their master's program and upcoming move to Edinburgh.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided a comparison of pros and cons for living in Marchmont versus the city center.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Pros of Marchmont: affordability, leafy neighborhood, quiet and peaceful, local amenities.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Cons of Marchmont: distance from campus, limited nightlife.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Pros of the city center: convenience, vibrant atmosphere, easy access to public transport.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Cons of the city center: higher rent prices, noise and crowds.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant suggested questions for the user to consider regarding their accommodation choice.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided approximate commute times from Marchmont to various University of Edinburgh campuses: 
  - Central Campus: 30-40 minutes walking, 20-30 minutes by bus.
  - King's Buildings Campus: 45-60 minutes walking, 30-40 minutes by bus.
  - Holyrood Campus: 35-45 minutes walking, 20-30 minutes by bus.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant recommended checking the Lothian Buses website or app for up-to-date timetables.

  - Cons: cost, noise and crowds, limited space.
